newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank to inject funds on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank to inject funds on Thursday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank will inject funds into the banking system on Thursday through open market operations, following the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, a bank official said.
The bank, through bills finance companies, will execute within-10-day open market operations on qualified securities instruments offered by interested financial institutions, the official said.
Bids will close at 11:00 a.m. (0300 GMT).
Anaysts said the move was one of the government's measures to stabilise the markets.
"The central bank will try to provide enough liquidity to help stabilise the markets, particularly the stock market," said David Yu, vice-president at International Investment Trust Co.
